name: Zoku Maid Sangekikan ~Semen Kichiku Choukyou~
original_name: 続･メイド惨劇館 ～ザーメン鬼畜調教～
source:
Kyle works at the residence of the noble. One day he witnesses maids attacked by men. He just stands and watches in a shocked state. This cruel night destroys those pale love feelings he was holding in his heart.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
凯尔在一名贵族的宅邸工作。一天，他亲眼看见女仆们遭到数名男子袭击，却因震惊而只能站在一旁观看。这个残酷的夜晚，彻底摧毁了他心中那份淡淡的爱慕。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
